**[SkillSpector Review]**

Decision: Approve the implementation.

### Value and readiness
The provider default, registry metadata, model-specific reasoning default, tests and user-facing examples consistently move to `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash`. The endpoint outage described in #1006 makes the compatibility fix useful. This approval does not establish model quality qualification or green CI.

### Material findings
No material implementation blocker found in the seven-file change. `src/skillspector/providers/nv_build/provider.py:48-50,74-77` selects the new default and limits the implicit `high` effort to that model. `create_openai_compatible_chat_model` continues to prefer an explicit nonblank effort, and model resolution continues to prefer the configured override. The bundled entry retains 128,000 context and 32,000 output as conservative application budgets. The changed provider assertions cover the new default, both limits, blank/default/explicit reasoning values, the retired/unknown-model cases and isolation from the OpenAI provider.

### PIC tradeoffs
The replacement has not been requalified against credential-disclosure or prompt-injection controls; `provider.py:43-49` discloses this rather than claiming equivalent detection. Restoring a served default trades the known endpoint failure for unmeasured semantic quality. Run the project's benign/malicious/refusal/incomplete-response acceptance controls before treating the flash model as qualified for security decisions. I did not make a live model request or independently verify the author's endpoint-liveness claim.

### Verification and gaps
Read the complete seven-file diff, pinned provider/registry/chat-construction source, all changed assertions and documentation, linked #1006, and the complete empty discussion/review history. Exact-head CI run 41734399631 has five successful checks and a failed `test-unit` check. Its failed log reports 15 shell-ownership assertions failing, with 17,858 passed; I read those failures. A comparable base run was not obtained, so I make no claim that they are pre-existing or caused by this model patch. CI remains a merge blocker. Live structured-output and scanner behavior remain unverified.
Static source review only. No contributor code, tests, snippets, imports, builds, setup, hooks, scanner invocations or model calls were executed.

Reviewed head: `70d7c1939278530664da9f13f171d7f3d8bf10a8`.
